text_block_list.text:
One day, I was summoned to the student 
council room along with Mayano Top Gun. 
Upon arriving...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Maya's gonna be a guest at a 
fashion show!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's part of the academy's PR event. 
We're asking the public what kind of 
racing outfits they'd like to see—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The wedding racewear showcased at the 
Beauty Dream Cup won 1st place. ...Which 
is why I summoned you, its owner.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Maya loved that outfit back then 
too~! Wait, huh? Does that mean――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, I will participate as well. 
After all, I am one of those in possession 
of an outfit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Also... as part of the plan, we're 
supposed to walk the runway with an 
escort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whether through an open call or direct 
nomination, the guest may freely choose 
whoever they like by the deadline.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
An escort, huh... An open recruitment, or 
a nomination? But Maya wants...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-If we open it up to public submissions, 
the fans would probably love it too! Or 
maybe we could ask Fuji-senpai, who's such 
a great escort?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“Still... if there's someone else who 
wants to say, 'Pick me!'... Um...”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaargh!! Why don't you ever listen to 
me?!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever...! If that's how it's 
gonna be, I'll just come up with a 
strategy!!"

Mayano Top Gun starts hatching some sort 
of plan. I decide to watch over her for 
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-senpai! Who did you pick as your 
escort? Everyone's dying to know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! Now I gotta hurry and find 
someone to sign up with meee~~! 
...*glance*.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to the event! 
If there's an open call for escorts, I'll 
definitely put my name forward!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's super popular☆ If nobody applies, 
maybe Maya should open a public call~? 
...*glance*.

Yet several days passed without her 
picking an escort. Just as I was wondering 
what to do...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I've come to conduct an 
inquiry. ...You know what this is about, 
don't you?
choice_data_list: This is about the escort role, right?
This is about the escort role, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand her hesitation, but we can't 
wait forever. I should tell her to reply 
soon—

Stooop! Trainer-chan, what is the meaning 
of this!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Reply quickly about being her escort...!? 
You're going to be Air Groove's escort!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya was... Maya was waiting for you to 
volunteer, you know~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's partner is Trainer-chan! Though I'd 
be happier if you asked me out instead of 
just assigning me...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting here thinking that, and you 
were picked by Air Groove-san all along?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second! What are you talking about? 
I already have someone else escorting me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Th-Then your "answer" about being 
my "escort"...
choice_data_list:
Just reminding you to apply for the escort 
role.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah! So Maya just jumped to 
conclusions?! Thank goodness~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... Sorry for the misunderstanding. 
I completely thought our "Tactical 
Bargaining Strategy" had failed—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... That's right! I wanted to show 
off Maya's popularity, make you nervous, 
and get you to say it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because I wanted to believe... that Maya 
is your special one, Trainer-chan, and 
that you cherish me most of all."
choice_data_list: Will you give me one more chance?

Of course, it's the most important thing 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I-If it's just this once, I guess I 
have no choice... ......Okay, fine."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Ehehe, I'm so happy."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll register it under Trainer. 
*sigh*... Just don't cause any trouble on 
the day, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! It's finally time for the real 
deal~. The outfit's all set! All that's 
left is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I know that, but my heart won't stop 
pounding! It feels like I'll never be 
fully ready~... But..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is that happy! ...Let's show them an 
amazing runway, okay?

Stepping out onto the runway with 
boundless energy, she brought the event to 
a resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...R-Really? Maya is special? The most 
precious, and the most sparkly?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! The plan failed, but since I 
learned how you feel, maybe all's well 
that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But still... be prepared, okay? On the big 
day, I'm gonna make you say something 
waaay more incredible☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Fine, I will register you as her 
Trainer. Just don't cause any trouble with 
this "amazing thing" of yours, understood?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay☆ Thank you for the cheers, everyone! 
Maya is so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I promise that Trainer-chan and I will 
keep bringing the sparkle together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right! Trainer-chan♪

The entire venue erupted at their 
declaration, bringing the event to a close 
amidst roaring success!
